description: Congo Brazzaville - HV Electricity Network (2019) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by World Bank Group. This data was collected during the project: Preparation of a high-level least-cost geospatial analysis for grid and off-grid electrification options Synoptic analysis of low-cost electrification solutions in Congo. Coverage: Congo. It has 3 files in SHP ZIP, XLS, GeoJSON. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
